column2: IU0VYT Flash — channels, repeaters and firmware for Baofeng, Quansheng, Retevis, Radtel and other brands of radios

IU0VYT Flash: free and open-source (GPL) program for Windows that reads and writes channels, frequencies and settings of transceivers of many brands (Baofeng, Bajeton, Quansheng, Retevis, Radtel, Radioddity, TIDRADIO…), recognizes them automatically, manages the Italian repeaters and updates the firmware.
Channels, repeaters and firmware for Baofeng, Bajeton, Quansheng, Retevis, Radtel and other brands of radios. Free of charge, free software, for Windows 10/11.

Free and open-source (GPL) program for Windows that reads and writes channels, frequencies and settings of transceivers of many brands (Baofeng, Bajeton, Quansheng, Retevis, Radtel, Radioddity, TIDRADIO…), manages the Italian repeaters and updates the firmware.
CHANNEL MANAGEMENT - FREQUENCIES - REPEATERS - FIRMWARE

The free Windows program that reads and writes the channels and frequencies of your radios via cable,
inserts the Italian repeaters and updates the firmware.
A single file, no installation, in Italian and 10 other languages.
The button always downloads the package of the latest published version.
To check that the file is intact, in Windows open the Command Prompt in the file's folder and type certutil -hashfile IU0VYT.Flash.zip SHA256: the result must be identical.
Extract the archive and start IU0VYT Flash.exe. It uses the WebView2 component, already present in an up-to-date Windows 10 and in Windows 11.

A single tool to program, convert and update the radios of # brands (Baofeng, Bajeton, Quansheng, Retevis, Radtel, Radioddity, TIDRADIO, TYT, Hiroyasu, Talkpod, Puxing, Feidaxin, Wouxun, AnyTone and others), designed for radio amateurs and for PMR446 radio users.
Reading and writing via cable of # models, including digital PMR and DMR radios, also via USB. CHIRP-compatible .img files and the original files of the K67 Pro (.xlc) and of the Bajeton 8300 (.dat).
Menus, display, VOX, squelch, TOT, DTMF, keys and more for # models, with an explanation of every item and a confirmation for the sensitive ones.

Connect the radio: the program recognizes it and shows make, model, firmware and, for DMR radios, ID and name. With automatic identification you just connect the cable: the program listens to all the ports, also recognizes several radios together and those turned on later, and opens their tabs; for another radio there is the «Identify Radio» button. Without writing anything to the radio.
The channels of any radio or file (K67, Bajeton, CHIRP images, CHIRP CSV, Excel) in the format of any other radio, adapted to its rules.
Archive based on the updated list by IK2ANE, with filters, automatic names, compatibility check and direct insertion into the radios.
Firmware of # models with the protocols of the official programs, file check and backup copy.
# radios of # brands divided by type (amateur, DMR, GMRS/FRS, PMR446, for children) and by brand, with search and links to the official programs and manuals.

Besides Italian, the program is available in English, French, German, Spanish, Portuguese, Russian, Chinese, Japanese, Korean and Arabic: choose the flag next to «Info» and the whole program changes language instantly. Guide and information translated in the lingue folder of the package.
Before every write the program saves the contents of the radio and afterwards checks that the data were written correctly.
At every start the program checks whether there is a newer version and downloads it from this same releases page.
You need a PC with Windows 10 or 11 and the radio's programming cable.
Download IU0VYT.Flash.zip from this page and extract the archive into a folder. There is nothing to install.
Open IU0VYT Flash.exe and, from the 📻 Models tab, choose your radio or use 🔎 Identify.
Connect the cable, press Read from radio, edit channels and repeaters and write everything to the radio.
The complete guide is in the file GUIDE.txt of the lingue/en folder included in the package (Italian original: LEGGIMI.txt).
